bio: In the words of Anecdote's owner Alexandre Gauthier, who is also chef at La Grenouillère, Samuel Pesquet creates a cuisine of memory – in it, he pays homage to the dishes his father used to make in the 1980s. This is generous and mouth-watering cuisine made from fine ingredients – goujonnettes with gribiche sauce, braised rib steak, crêpes Suzette or tarte Tatin – that you won't be forgetting any time soon....
